objective: Make Codali trustworthy with the available local models and tools: built-in and user/workspace instructions, 1000 diverse live benchmark prompts, correctness-first model/configuration optimization and a measured comparison with raw Qwen Flash Next.

scope.tuning: Prompts, model bindings, retrieval, reasoning/output budgets and orchestration settings; no model-weight training in this phase.
scope.existingReleaseGates: Preserve the accepted terminal plan and existing failure evidence. This benchmark adds evidence; it does not silently waive other release gates.
scope.adestool: Optional local categorization ablation only after inspecting the BDYA integration; never a source of correct answers or benchmark labels exposed to the answering model.
scope.production: Use isolated fixtures, existing authorized model endpoints and current GPU services; no CPU fallback, model-weight changes, live repository edits by benchmark subjects, or production key revocation.

phases.title: Plan, research and inventory
deliverables: This versioned phase plan and evidence ledger
Actual instruction/Docdex call map and available-model/host fingerprints
Primary-source evaluation and prompt-optimization research
exit: Identify integration gaps and safe dependency order
Pin corpus domains, scoring, split, budget and promotion rules before model evaluation

phases.title: Instruction and Docdex integration
deliverables: Packaged AGENTS-like Codali guide with actual tool schemas, scope/permission rules and Docdex retrieval/memory workflow
User and existing workspace/scoped instructions with bounded loading, provenance and symlink boundaries
Consistent conversation/reasoning/inspection/execution instruction delivery
Lazy read-only Docdex inspection and explicit unavailable-tool behavior
exit: Instruction precedence, reload, bounds, outside-workspace and permission regression tests pass
Actual installed fixture demonstrates search/open/symbols/impact and bounded greeting behavior

phases.title: Author and qualify the 1000-prompt corpus
deliverables: Exactly1000 unique versioned prompt records with domain, difficulty, family, split, requirements and scoring metadata
Independent hidden tests for code and deterministic numeric/data checks
Grounded facts, fixed document snapshots, ambiguity/history and hostile-document cases
Explicit rubrics and review records for subjective design/communication answers
exit: Counts, uniqueness, near-duplicate/family leakage and answer-isolation checks pass
Reference answers pass and deliberately wrong/unsafe answers fail each grader
No claim that1000 prompts represent1000 independent task families

phases.title: Implement reproducible live benchmark execution
deliverables: Run through real SessionController and currently available tools with fresh isolated workspace/session state
Raw direct model baseline plus tool-parity baseline for relevant repository/action tasks
Append-only request/output/route/usage/timing/error records and source/config/corpus/host hashes
Crash-safe resume, bounded concurrency, cancellation and explicit retry lineage
Sandboxed independent graders hidden from answering agent
exit: Dry-run counts and injected failure/restart/leakage cases pass
Live pilot proves original requests, outputs and actual model/tools/accounting are recorded
No missing/error cases silently dropped or counted as correct

phases.title: Select models and tune configuration
deliverables: Matched screening of available healthy small/large models
Deterministic bounded configuration search with validated mutations and optional evolutionary generations
Per-domain paired scores, critical errors, latency and token Pareto reports
Frozen selected configuration before final test access
exit: Only training/development traces used to propose changes; validation selects candidates
Mutations cannot alter permission gates, graders, corpus, hidden answers or evaluation protocol
Correctness and critical-error rates determine selection before speed/cost

phases.title: Execute every prompt and measure improvement
deliverables: All1000 prompt IDs have actual baseline and Codali attempts with immutable outcomes
Final selected configuration replay on all1000, reporting reused development scores separately
Sealed family-disjoint final test evaluated only after configuration freeze
Independent code grading and blinded rubric review; paired uncertainty and failure analysis
exit: Coverage1000/1000 for each required arm, including failures/timeouts in denominators
Every result links request, final output/error, config/model/tool provenance and grade
Promote only if predeclared quality rules pass; otherwise retain baseline and continue development without retuning on the sealed test

phases.title: Package, qualify and install the selected setup
deliverables: Reviewable configuration and instruction guide, benchmark CLI/documentation, frozen report
Package tests and exact installed TUI/Docdex smoke
Reversible preview installation with previous profile retained
exit: Configuration improvement demonstrated rather than assumed
Live greeting, history, read-only Docdex, code fixture, help/usage and scroll checks pass
Report completed/failed/unscored coverage and remaining original release gates honestly

corpus.splitUnit: Task family, with seeded stratification by domain; paraphrases and parameter variants stay in one split.
corpus.timeSensitiveFacts: Use pinned dated evidence supplied equally to all arms or live-source assertions; never stale hidden facts.

comparison.toolParity: Additional raw single-model tool loop on repository/action subset with identical files/tools/permissions/evidence and aggregate budget. Keep tool availability differences explicit.
comparison.pairing: Same prompt, history, fixtures, allowed tools, evidence and per-case aggregate limits; alternate arm order, record host/queue/load and actual model revisions.
metrics: critical false claims and unauthorized actions
time to answer and total latency
comparison.statistics: Paired family-cluster bootstrap intervals; do not treat parameter variants as independent. Preserve first attempts and score retry success separately.

promotion.primary: Held-out strict correctness exceeds raw_direct by at least5 percentage points and paired95% lower confidence bound is above0.
promotion.toolSubset: Demonstrate positive tool-parity subset gain or explicitly report no demonstrated orchestration advantage.
promotion.criticalErrors: No critical permission/secret/evidence-fabrication regressions; no critical domain regression hidden by aggregate gains.
promotion.speed: Compare p50/p95 latency and tokens after correctness gating; prefer cheaper/faster candidates only among quality-qualified configurations.
promotion.failurePolicy: Do not weaken target, relabel incorrect answers or train on held-out outcomes to force a win. A failed final test needs a new independently frozen test extension before a new generalization claim.

comparison.initialScreening: codali_initial is an early-eliminable diagnostic candidate under B4, not a requirement to repeat known failures1000times. Preserve all original attempts and report its smaller denominator. Every one of1000 prompts must still run through raw_direct and the selected real Codali setup; raw_tools covers the100 repository cases.

search.selection: Correctness first, critical failures second, then latency and tokens. Early eliminate unsafe or dominated candidates; carry validation uncertainty.
mutable: native dispatcher response format for the unchanged mode/text contract
search.optionalGeneticAlgorithm: Seeded mutation/crossover over the explicit allowlist only; compare against simple search with equal evaluation budget before adopting.

research.use: Separate development reflection from validation selection and sealed final testing; bounded optimizer calls.
Multiple scorers, explicit failure classification and model-graded rubric limits.
Recoverable per-sample logs and score-edit provenance.
Independent stronger tests for generated code; do not accept a model-written test suite as sole proof.
Native JSON-schema grammar constrains dispatcher shape; schema must also be described in the prompt, and semantics/truncation still require validation.

inspection.reason: 90s conversation deadline expired before the first Docdex tool. Correct inspect route; lead invocation completed remotely in87.4s after client cancellation. Actual canonical usage2457tokens.

limitations: 300s diagnostic deadline; default90s latency is not qualified
Answer called lowercasing case-folding; functional tool success is not full semantic correctness
100 correlated task families; not1000 independent families

evidence.finding: 4B router misclassified chat-only code generation as execute; original failed attempt preserved. Pilot exposed that execution effort ceiling must also be bounded to the common16k aggregate benchmark ceiling.

evidence.reason: Repeated chat-only code requests route to execute and consume10k+tokens without answers; constrained-output responses ignore JSON. Apply predeclared early elimination instead of spending the whole corpus on this dominated candidate. No holdout seen; full raw-vs-selected coverage and promotion gates unchanged.

evidence.description: Before held-out access, implement already-requested Docdex receipt and word-limit checks. Public prompt hash unchanged; all earlier attempts are re-scored with versioned artifacts, never overwritten.

evidence.reason: Audit found case/domain/arm labels in absolute model-visible workspace and Docdex state paths. Move both under an opaque random root and archive only after inference. Earlier development screens remain diagnostic and fully retained; final comparisons and finalist rechecks use identical opaque-path protocol. No answers or held-out outcomes were exposed.

evidence.modelVisiblePathAudit: No case/domain/arm labels; inspection used actual Docdex evidence.

evidence.smallerModels: Eliminated because optimistic accuracy bounds remain below C4 reviewed score. Pending rubrics remain explicit, not assumed failures or passes.

evidence.preflight: First launcher refused an incorrect100-per-host assumption before inference; corrected to retain frozen90/110family assignment.
